name: ktc-production-control-desktop
description: KTC Production Control Desktop - remote FE + shared BE, native Excel/desktop functions
author: KTC

scripts.dist:win: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:portable: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:portable:fast: npm run preflight && npm run test:machine-time && npm run test:cvk-export && electron-builder --win portable --x64 --config.compression=store --publish never
scripts.dist:nsis: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.check: node --check electron/launcher.cjs && node --check electron/deploymentProfile.cjs && node --check tests/deployment-profile.test.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/platformPaths.cjs && node --check scripts/preflight.cjs && node --check scripts/checkPlatformPaths.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && node --check electron/desktopLog.cjs && node --check electron/excelPaths.cjs && node --check electron/authToken.cjs && node --check electron/companyExcelLocal.cjs && node --check electron/productionCalculationEngine.cjs && node --check electron/excelDualLayout.cjs && node --check electron/monthlyWorkbookLocal.cjs && node --check electron/workerReportTemplateLocal.v2.cjs && node --check electron/excelExportContractPatch.v6.cjs && node --check tests/cvk-product-code.test.cjs && node --check scripts/smokeExcel.cjs && npm run check:excel-db-sync && npm run check:platform-paths && node --check scripts/fieldReadiness.cjs && node scripts/fieldReadiness.cjs && node scripts/checkPackagedSharedContract.cjs && node --check electron/autoUpdate.cjs && npm run test:deployment-profile
scripts.smoke:excel: npm run test:machine-time && npm run test:cvk-export && node --test tests/mai-do-export-parity.test.cjs && node scripts/smokeExcel.cjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.dist:win:test: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:production: npm run preflight && npm run smoke:excel && electron-builder --config electron-builder.production.json --win portable nsis --x64 --publish never
